resources.string: Control your phone with air hand gestures

AirX1 lets you control this phone with hand gestures seen by the front camera. When enabled, it draws a cursor on screen and performs taps, swipes and navigation actions (Back, Home, Recents) on your behalf, but only while you have armed it with a gesture. It also watches which window is open (for example, when the keyboard appears) to make the cursor more precise. All camera processing happens on this device: AirX1 has no internet permission and never saves or sends camera images.
AirX1 is watching for your hand
Camera is processed on-device only. Tap Stop to turn off.
